stage: M70 training fidelity: supplied direction and encoded direction on original background
population: All70 existing training pairs,18bound models,MLP1,source/final/identity. Two shared source alignment omissions retained separately.
reconstructed_direction: Encode/decode each original native donor and recipient write independently with its own TopK/gates, frozen model/normalization. Difference at the same M59aligned source/final addresses; zero elsewhere. Decoder bias/mean cancel algebraically but preserve actual float32 implementation. No recipient-support locking or norm matching.
targets: Native background plus native delta response is teacher. Responses each relative to their own background. Reconstructed background plus native delta replays M62 exactly. Compute remaining native-background/reconstructed-delta and reconstructed-background/reconstructed-delta corners; identities retained.
metrics: Local delta squared error normalized by native delta energy; full-vocabulary native-weighted response error normalized by native response energy; raw energies/margin errors and per-family/pooled/equal-family scores. Missing zero denominators explicit. Same teacher across candidates.
interpretation: Separates background-response fidelity from encoding task differences; finite nonlinear interaction means no additive causal attribution. Familiar source-group development evaluation, not discovery or whole-task transfer.
stop: One factorial across all candidates and fixed inputs. No fit, floor/LR/seed/position/task search. Then assess readiness for component/manifold validation, rather than claiming units from reconstruction or response alone.
